instruction: Place the text box on the extreme right edge of the image.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text box to the right side of the image in GIMP. The evaluator exports the image and checks if the rightmost text pixel is within the right 5% of the image width (2192 pixels). The custom getter scans the image from right to left to find the rightmost dark pixel (text), and the metric verifies it's positioned on the right side (x > 2192 * 0.95 = 2082.4). This mirrors the original task which checked for left positioning.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly finds the rightmost text pixel by scanning each row from right to left and taking the maximum x-coordinate
Metric correctly verifies text is on the right side using a 5% threshold (x > 2192 * 0.95 = 2082.4), which is reasonable for 'far right' positioning
Postconfig appropriately exports the image to enable verification of the final state
Expected value (image_width: 2192) matches the source file dimensions
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor edge case: If the rightmost text pixel is at x=0, the metric treats it as 'no text found' (returns 0.0). Consider using 'result is None' only, or add explicit check for x >= 0

The 5% threshold assumes text box width - if text is very wide (e.g., 300px), rightmost pixel at x=2100 might not mean the box is 'far right'. Consider documenting this assumption or checking text box center/left edge instead
Image width is hardcoded (2192) rather than extracted from the actual image. Consider validating actual image dimensions match expected to catch canvas resize issues
Postconfig relies on pyautogui timing and assumes export dialog behavior - this may be fragile at runtime but is acceptable for this verification approach
